info.description: REST API for the Lumie K-12 academy SaaS monolith. Protected browser routes use an HttpOnly session cookie. Validation, authentication, authorization, business, and unexpected errors use application/problem+json with top-level code and timestamp. The development cookie name is lumie_session; production uses __Host-lumie_session. Some operations apply additional role and ownership checks.
